adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh flow is implemented via an inline `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and does not use the newly introduced `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` helper that gates credential-sync via `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`. As a result, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is active, Salesforce will still perform the direct refresh call and never hit the sync endpoint, unlike other integrations updated in this diff (e.g., Zoom/O365/Webex). The claim that “jsforce already handles refresh” can’t be verified from this diff, but the missing use of `refreshOAuthTokens` (and thus missing sync support) is directly verifiable.
